about: Award wins (P166) and nominations (P1411) recorded on Wikidata for people with a TMDB person ID (P4985), in the categories listed, read by tools/recognition/build.mjs. Only what Wikidata states is here; a category or a year it does not state is absent, not guessed. `fame` is how many Wikipedia editions have an article on each person with a TMDB ID and at least 10 (Wikidata sitelinks), read by tools/recognition/fame.mjs.
